top_signals.title: LIV Golf Files for Bankruptcy Protection
top_signals.summary: LIV Golf filed for bankruptcy protection, a dramatic fall for the Saudi-backed league that had big ambitions to challenge the supremacy of the PGA Tour. Randall Williams has more on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
